goal: Reject HTTP requests with invalid or unsupported Transfer-Encoding headers with a 400 response
Prevent HTTP request framing inconsistencies when clients or proxies send unsupported transfer encodings
agreement: Asked when users encounter unsupported encodings since bitcoin-cli avoids them (winterrdog)

why: P2 because it prevents HTTP request framing inconsistencies for custom clients or reverse proxies
